title: The number of geometric connected components of fibres of a proper flat finitely presented map is lower semi-continuous
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y proper, flat, of finite presentation between spaces over S, the function n_{X/Y} on |Y| counting geometric connected components of the fibres is lower semi-continuous. The retained proof is complete: etale-localize Y to an affine scheme; for y with n = n_{X/Y}(y) finite (Noetherian fibre), take the general Stein factorization X -> Y' -> Y (same wave, L16200); the Stein-fibre lemma (chapter lemma stein-universally-closed-residue-fields, in the revived queue) gives exactly finitely many points y'_1..y'_m of Y' over y with finite residue extensions; an etale neighbourhood splits Y' into disjoint scheme pieces V_i through the schemes-side etale-splits-integral lemma (More on Morphisms, lemma etale-makes-integral-split) with purely inseparable residue extensions, so the fibres X_{y'_i} are geometrically connected over k(y) and m = n; the pieces X_i = (f')^{-1}(V_i) are flat finitely presented over Y hence have OPEN images (Morphisms of Spaces, lemma fppf-open); on the common neighbourhood of the y-images, n_{X/Y} >= n. Retained author proof at lines 8360-8384.
